issues.legal_issue: A co-owner’s transfer of an undivided share in inherited property is valid to the extent of the share the transferor is entitled to convey.
A decree granting possession of property beyond the plaintiff’s share cannot be made where the other co-owners have not sought that relief and necessary parties have not been joined.
A court cannot grant partition-like relief in an estate-administration suit after rejecting the principal administration claim, particularly when necessary parties are absent.
A co-owner in possession cannot be disturbed before the property is partitioned in accordance with law.
